channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Indonesia deploys dry ice to combat wildfire haze
item.description: Indonesia is experimenting with dispersing dry ice from planes over South Sumatra as a new tactic to combat the toxic haze caused by widespread wildfires. The fires have been emitting smoke that has drawn criticism from neighboring… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mont Blanc Height Increases by Nearly Two Meters
item.description: Mont Blanc, Europe's highest peak, has increased in height by almost two meters compared to measurements taken three years ago. The current height is reported as 4,807.47 meters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Scientists Warn Climate Change Accelerating Beyond Response Capacity
item.description: Scientists are warning that climate change is accelerating at a pace faster than humanity can respond to, according to reports. A book argues that accelerating climate change is the most serious threat facing the world today. Additionally… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Human-Elephant Conflict Takes Deadly Toll in Sri Lanka
item.description: The human-elephant conflict in Sri Lanka has resulted in a deadly toll, with the conflict claiming lives. The specific number of casualties or the exact timeframe of the reported toll were not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Southeast Asia Haze Worsens, Triggering Mask Distribution and School Closures
item.description: Haze from intensifying Indonesian wildfires has worsened air quality across Southeast Asia, prompting Singapore to accelerate its distribution of N95 masks. In East Timor, schools were shut due to the pollution. Reporting from Singapore… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Atlantic Ocean Currents and Coral Reefs Show Signs of Recovery
item.description: A study indicates that Atlantic Ocean currents, which have experienced severe climate weakening, possess the capacity to recover. Separately, research has found that bleached coral can rebound after coming into contact with healthy coral. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Monsoon Activity Expected in Parts of India, Clear Skies Elsewhere
item.description: Parts of Madhya Pradesh, including Gwalior-Chambal and Vindhya regions, are forecast to experience rain with thunder and lightning across 20 districts. In contrast, Bhopal and Indore are expected to have clear weather. Meanwhile, in Bihar… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Indonesia Rescues and Releases Endangered Wildlife
item.description: Indonesian authorities have rescued and released endangered animals on separate occasions. In one instance, 20 green sea turtles were released into the ocean after a smuggling attempt in Bali was foiled. In another operation, eight… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Wildfire Prompts Evacuations North of Los Angeles
item.description: A wildfire north of Los Angeles has prompted an evacuation order for parts of Santa Clarita. The fire is located in an area where residents had previously escaped wildfires, and now face the threat of the ocean. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kashmir's higher reaches receive fresh snowfall
item.description: The higher reaches of Jammu and Kashmir have experienced fresh snowfall, while the plains are expected to receive rain until October 15. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Libya Floods Kill Two, Submerge Homes and Hospitals
item.description: Torrential rains caused severe flooding in Tripoli, Libya, resulting in two fatalities. The floods submerged cars, homes, and hospitals in the capital city. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Air Quality Monitoring Network Expanded with New Stations
item.description: Delhi's air quality monitoring network has been expanded with the addition of 13 new air quality monitoring stations. The government has also introduced 150 electric buses to combat pollution. This initiative aims to enhance pollution… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Activist's river cleanup efforts undone by renewed pollution
item.description: Activist Bittu Tabahi has found the Ajnar River littered with waste again, just weeks after completing an eight-month cleanup effort. Tabahi's work had previously sparked discussions on public responsibility and the persistent issue of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Telangana Farmers Demand Drought Tag Amidst Rain Deficit and Falling Yields
item.description: Farmers in Telangana's Adilabad district are demanding a drought tag due to a rain deficit and falling crop yields. Shepherds are reportedly traveling long distances in search of water and pasture. The situation highlights agricultural… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: California Coast Hit by Powerful Waves and Flooding
item.description: Southern California coastal communities experienced intense waves and flooding over the weekend, battering beachside homes and destroying boardwalks, particularly in Long Beach. The extreme weather, linked to Tropical Storm Rachel, also… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Storms kill five in Mexico; Hurricane Simon approaches
item.description: Tropical weather systems have caused five deaths and damage in Pacific coastal towns and resorts in Mexico. Hurricane Simon is moving slowly up the west-central coast, bringing wind and flooding rain. German nationals were among those… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: ASEAN to Discuss Transboundary Haze Ahead of Summit
item.description: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is set to discuss tackling transboundary haze pollution in the lead-up to its November summit. Malaysia has indicated that this issue will be on the agenda. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nashik groundwater has 1,000 times safe limit of cancer-causing chromium
item.description: Laboratory tests of groundwater in Nashik have revealed the presence of hexavalent chromium, a known carcinogen, at levels 1,000 times above the safe limit for drinking water. The contamination was detected in water from the Nandini river… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Invasive Red Fire Ants Discovered in Sydney
item.description: Deadly red fire ants, described as one of the world's most invasive species, have been discovered in Sydney's inner west. Authorities are addressing the discovery of this invasive species. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Tanker Fire in Arabian Gulf; 22 Rescued
item.description: An oil tanker caught fire in the Arabian Gulf, leading to the rescue of 22 individuals by the UAE National Guard. The incident occurred in the Arabian Gulf. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: UK Weather: Warm Start Followed by Mid-Week Rain
item.description: The United Kingdom is expected to experience a warm start to the week, with temperatures remaining mild. However, this is forecast to be followed by a period of wet weather mid-week. The change in conditions comes after a recent spell of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal Floods Destroy Homes and Bridges
item.description: Severe floods in Nepal have caused widespread destruction, with 35 houses and 10 bridges washed away. The floods, originating from the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha, have disrupted transportation and isolated large areas. Emergency… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Wildfire Prompts Evacuations in Santa Clarita, California
item.description: A wildfire, identified as the Bike fire, north of Los Angeles in Santa Clarita prompted an evacuation order for parts of the area. Fire crews worked to contain the blaze, and residents were later allowed to return to their homes as the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Indonesia Rescues Orangutans from Borneo Fires
item.description: Indonesian authorities have moved eight endangered orangutans to safety following fires in Borneo. The orangutans were rescued from the fires and released into a protected forest area. Communities in Indonesian Borneo are actively fighting… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Ken-Betwa Project Floods Homes, Temples; Protests Erupt
item.description: Protests have erupted against the Ken-Betwa river-linking project following reports of flooded homes and submerged temples. Separately, floods in Nepal caused by a landslide blocking the Budhi Gandaki River have swept away homes and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: PMK Leader Appeals to Save Palmyra Trees from Felling
item.description: PMK leader Sowmiya Anbumani has appealed to protect Palmyra trees from being felled. The appeal focuses on the preservation of these trees. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sikkim CM Advocates for Fish Species and River Conservation
item.description: Sikkim Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang has emphasized the importance of conserving indigenous fish species and protecting aquatic biodiversity. He also stressed the need for river conservation efforts. The focus is on safeguarding the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: El Niño Linked to Extreme Weather Events Globally
item.description: El Niño has been linked to extreme weather events worldwide, including record rainfall in Tokyo and a desert bloom in Chile. Tokyo experienced 35 consecutive days of rain, its highest in centuries, attributed to El Niño. Additionally, a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Northern Lights Expected to be Visible Across UK and US
item.description: The Northern Lights are anticipated to be visible across the UK on Sunday night. Similar displays are also expected to return to 28 states in the US on Sunday, following previous epic displays. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rain damages crops in Haryana and Punjab, farmers concerned
item.description: Heavy rainfall has impacted paddy and wheat crops in Gohana, Haryana, causing concern among farmers. In Fazilka, Punjab, rain has damaged grain markets, leading to an estimated loss of crores of rupees worth of paddy. Farmers in Haryana… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: Yemen Faces Worsening Humanitarian Crisis Amidst Renewed Fighting
item.description: Yemen's humanitarian crisis is escalating, with over 184,000 people displaced since August due to renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops. Aid agencies report a growing hunger emergency, and mobile health… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Flash Flood Devastates Nepal, Sweeping Away Homes and Bridges
item.description: A flash flood triggered by heavy rain and a landslide in Nepal's Gorkha district has swept away over 35 houses and several bridges. The Budhi Gandaki River turned black and grey as the floodwaters inundated villages, leading to mass… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 18 · Right 4.

item.title: Mudslide sweeps cars and bus down street in Chile
item.description: A mudslide carrying floodwater surged down a street in Chile, sweeping away cars and a bus. The force of the muddy water created a pile of vehicles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Telangana warns of power, water crisis due to El Niño
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has warned of a potential power and water crisis in the state, attributing the threat to the impact of El Niño. Reports suggest the state may have failed to conserve water and secure adequate coal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Faces Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms, and Hail
item.description: Uttar Pradesh experienced a significant shift in weather on Tuesday, with several districts in the Terai and Purvanchal regions recording a drop in temperature due to thunderstorms, strong winds, and rain. In Lucknow, approximately 40,000… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: Over 500 Trees to Be Removed at D.C. Golf Course for Redesign
item.description: More than 500 trees are slated for removal at a historic golf course in Washington D.C. to facilitate a redesign. The redesign is reportedly desired by President Donald Trump. The Park Service is overseeing the tree removal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: 4.2 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand
item.description: A 4.2-magnitude earthquake occurred in Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand, on Saturday night, causing panic among residents who rushed outdoors. This is the second tremor above magnitude 4 to hit Uttarakhand in four days. No damage has been reported. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Powerful tornado strikes western Sicily
item.description: A powerful tornado has struck western Sicily, causing damage to buildings and cars in the towns of Marsala and Petrosino. Dramatic footage shows the tornado moving through the affected areas. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias batters US Southeast, causing power outages and two deaths
item.description: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in the US Southeast, battering Florida and Alabama with extreme winds and flash flooding. The storm left approximately 800,000 people without power. Two fatalities have been reported. Officials warned of… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 15 · Right 2.

item.title: Earthquake tremors felt in Uttarakhand's Uttarkashi region
item.description: Earthquake tremors were felt in the Uttarkashi district headquarters and the Yamunotri valley in Uttarakhand. The tremors registered a magnitude of 4.2 in Uttarkashi at 8:08 PM. Earlier, a 2.8 magnitude earthquake was felt in Bageshwar… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.
